# posthog-mcp

> MCP server: PostHog capture / identify / feature flags for AI agents. Mock by default.

## Summary

posthog-mcp exposes four Model Context Protocol tools so agents can emit analytics and read feature flags without a browser. Default transport is stdio. Default backend is an in-memory mock; optional live PostHog via env.

## Tools

- capture_event: Capture analytics event (distinctId, event, properties?)
- identify_user: Identify person with properties (distinctId, properties)
- get_feature_flag: Evaluate flag (distinctId, flagKey, personProperties?)
- list_feature_flags: List known flags (no args)

## Modes

- mock (default): no credentials; seeded flags new-onboarding, beta-insights, pricing-experiment
- live: POSTHOG_MODE=live + POSTHOG_API_KEY (+ optional POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY, POSTHOG_HOST)

## Run

```
npm install
npm run eval
npm run dev
```

## Docs

- AGENT.md — agent operating manual for these tools
- README.md — human setup and MCP host config

## Constraints

- No auth server, no database, no HTTP MCP endpoint in this slice
- stdout is JSON-RPC only; use stderr for logs
- Keep tool surface ≤ 5 tools
